text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Sigh... Today's mock race went completely 
terribly...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Why can't I be like the other girls...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no, no good. I need to get to 
sleep quickly and reset my mindset."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to fall asleep with such a restless 
heart, Win Variation spent the night wide 
awake...
